blocked_leg.with-AI: inherits P33/P34 blockers: no user AI provider account, no human evaluators

g0_amendments: spec_ref made relative to the study file location (resolver resolves relative to the study, not the CWD)

decision rules gained an optional times_s scope: rank_equal previously evaluated at every shared cooling time, which cannot express the declared 'at 100 y' decision; gap found on first flagship execution, field added and rank rules scoped to 100 y
options set to mode=trace + outputs=[pathways]: pathway decomposition only runs in trace mode with the pathways output enabled; coupled mode silently emits empty pathway_closure
actinv binary re-sealed after decision-rule times_s feature addition (the G0 amendment records both the schema change and the rebuilt identity)
outputs extended to [pathways, photons]: pathway-only output suppressed photon_source_per_group, leaving every comparison rule undefined; both outputs are required by the frozen response list

binary re-sealed after CollapsedLibrary::validate_flux fix: the validator compared raw flux bits, but collapsed rates are flux-denominator-normalized — only the spectrum shape is collapse-relevant. Bit-exact validation wrongly rejected every flux_rel_std sample (24/24 failed on first execution); shape-normalized validation preserves the fail-closed guarantee and restores intended reuse
